tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dpal yang dag thugs kyi snying po las: phrin las dngos grub char 'beb bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈ he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa yis: phrin las 'jug la sbyor dngos rjes: sbyor ba sgrub pa'i yo byad bsham: skyabs 'gro tshogs gsag mtshams gcad dbye: phyag bshags dam bca' byin gyis brlab: dngos gzhi bskyed rim bsgom pa ni: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: dharma dhā tu ā: bo dhi tsitta hūm̐: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang nyid las: 'byung lnga'i rtog pa rnam par dag: nam mkha' rlung chen rakta'i mtsho: zhing chen sa gzhi keng rus ri: bskal pa'i me 'bar dur khrod zhing: srung ba'i sprin chen 'khrigs pa'i dbus: rgyu las paṃ maṃ pad nyi'i steng: hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus: bhrūm̐ yig lnga ldan gzhal yas khang: phyi ni rin chen rgyan dang ldan: nang ni dur khrod chas kyis 'jigs: dbus su zla gam dgu ldan pa'i: 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du: rdo rje'i brag steng ru dra ni: gan rkyal sgyel steng pad nyi zla: de dbus rgyu yi hūm̐ yig las: dpal chen yang dag he ru ka: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: khro 'dzum spyan dgu mche ba gtsigs: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bhan 'khor lo 'phen: zhabs bzhi gar gyi rnam par rol: dur khrod chas kyis 'jigs par byas: pang du badzra rnal 'byor ma: kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud: me dpung 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs: kun gzhi bde chen ngo bor bsgom: yab kyi gsang ba rdo rje hūm̐: yum gyi gsang ba padma ā: gnas lngar 'bru lnga gnas gsum la: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gsal: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: rā ga ya ho: rā ga yā mi: yab yum sbyor ba'i byang sems las: shar phyogs gau rī dkar mo ni: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar thabs bsgyur:

lho phyogs tsau 'u rī ma ser: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar stabs bsgyur: nub phyogs pra mo ha dmar mo: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar stabs bsgyur: byang phyogs bai tā li ljang nag: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar stabs bsgyur: shar lhor tsanḍa lī dkar ser: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar stabs bsgyur: lho nub pukka si dmar ser: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar thabs bsgyur: nub byang sme sha ni dmar ljang: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar stabs bsgyur: byang shar ghasma rī ljang ser: ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga: thod chang 'dzin pas gar stabs bsgyur: thams cad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: 'ja' dang me dpung klong du gsal:(phyi rol seng ha dbang phyug rnams: mgron thabs bzhin du gsal bar bsgom: 'di gnyis gter mchan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā ā darsha dzñā na badzra= oṃ ma hā sa ma tā dzñā na badzra= oṃ ma hā pra ti bekṣā ṇa dzñā na badzra= oṃ ma hā kṛtyānuṣṭha na dzñā na badzra= oṃ shrī he ru ka badzra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: a ti bhu ho: pra ti bhu ho: hūm̐: rdo rje sgeg mo gau 'u rī: sgeg pa'i gar gyis g.yo bar byas: nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: chags pa'i tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra gau'u rī sa ma ya st+waṃ: hūm̐: rdo rje phreng ba tsau 'u rī: bde ba'i gar gyis khyab par byas: nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: 'khril ba'i tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra tsau'u rī sa ma ya ho: hūm̐: rdo rje glu ma pra mo ha: mnyen pa'i tshul gyis brtan par byas:

nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: srub pa'i tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra pra mo haḥr ho haṃ: hūm̐: rdo rje gar ma bai tā li: myos pa'i gar gyis mthar son pa: nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: gnyis med tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra bai tā li rā ga yā mi: hūm̐: rdo rje me tog tsaṇḍa lī: gzugs mdzes gar gyis g.yo bar byas: nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: 'dzum pa'i tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī puṣpe pu: hūm̐: rdo rje bdug spos pukka si: dri zhim tshul gyis khyab par byas: nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: yid 'phrog tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra pukka si dhū pe dhū: hūm̐: rdo rje snang mdzad sme sha ni: snang gsal tshul gyis brtan par byas: nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: bde ba'i tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra sme sha ni ā lo ke ā: hūm̐: rdo rje dri chab ghasma rī: gnyis med tshul gyis mthar son pa: nam mkha' mnyam par sprul byas te: mi phyed tshul gyis sku la sbyor: oṃ badzra ghasma rī ghandhe ghan: ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi: sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: shrī badzra he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma hā mu dra su kha ho: ma traṃ ru dra pra we sha ya phaṭa: dharma dhā tu pū dzaḥho: hūm̐: zla gam 'bar ba'i klong dgu nas: ru dra bsgyel pa'i gdan steng du: de bzhin nyid las sku bzhengs pa: dpal chen yang dag he ru ka: chos sku 'gyur med mthing nag la: sku gsum ldan pa'i zhal gsum pa: rdo rje ye shes snying po che: kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum sgrol: thod rngas rnal 'byor ye shes spor: dril bus sems can sad par mdzad: dung khrag 'khor ba gnas nas spor: rgyu zhags thugs rje'i dpyang thag 'phen: bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i zhabs bzhi bsgrad: ru dra'i chos rnams ma spangs par: lhun grub dur khrod chas kyis brgyan:

he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni: badzra kro dhī shwa rī ma: kha ṭwāṃ thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku yi bdag nyid gau rī ma: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsung gi bdag nyid pra mo ha: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kyi bdag nyid tsaṇḍa lī: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan bdag nyid tsau rī ma: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las bdag nyid bai tā li: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes bdag nyid pukka si: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzi brjid bdag nyid sme sha ni: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: dngos grub bdag nyid ghasma rī: rnal 'byor kha ṭwāṃ ḍā ma ru: bde ba che la sbyor mdzad ma: rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus: hūm̐ yig mar me ltar 'bar ba: ru lu 'bru brgyad 'khor ba las: byang sems rang bzhin sngags phreng ni: yab yum zhal brgyud bde chen rgyas: phar 'phros rgyal ba thams cad mchod: tshur 'dus dngos grub bdag la thim: slar 'phros 'gro ba'i don rnams byas: snang srid thams cad sngags kyis gang: phyi snod zla gam gzhal yas khang: nang bcud rnal 'byor ma yi sku: bde chen 'khor lo chen por shar: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: ru lu 'bru brgyad sngags bzlas pas: ma mo thams cad dbang du bsdus: dregs pa thams cad bran du bkol:

ci 'dod las rnams 'grub par bsam: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: rjes kyi bya ba tshogs 'khor bskor: bskul zhing gtor skyong brtan ma gtang: bro brdung dngos grub blang ba dang: dkyil bsdu bkra shis bsngo smon bya: de yis phrin las cho ga rdzogs: 'dis ni mchog gi dngos grub thob: thun mong dngos grub lta ci smos: sa ma ya rgya: ྈྈྈྈ mchog gyur gling pa'i gter ma yang dag pa'o// //
